title: Season Ticket Buyer Value and Secondary Market Options
authors: Michael V. Lewis; Yanwen Wang; Chunhua Wu
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Structural dynamic model of season-ticket holders' purchase, attendance and resale decisions estimated by MLE and MCMC; package ships only a simulation exercise.
design_notes: SeasonTicketSimulation/main.m calls simulate.m (1,000 simulated customers, 5 seasons, 81 games) and mle.m, then runs GPU MCMC; multireg.m is a Bayesian multivariate regression step inside the sampler. No treatment-timing variable or panel FE regression.
data_files: (generated by simulate.m; no data file shipped)
data_files_note: Data are generated by simulate.m; the team's season-ticket data are not shipped.
data_provenance_note: README: code replicates 'our estimation results in the simulation exercise'; data simulated in simulate.m.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract is a one-sentence summary. Even if the article contains a reduced-form comparison around a secondary-market change, the package ships no real data. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
